# `newsletter` — module reference

Rendered from the module's own manifest, and from nothing written by hand. What the module *does* is [its own page](../modules/newsletter.md).

## Activation

An operator switches this module on and off on **/platform/modules**. The choice is the setting `newsletter.enabled`, and it defaults to **on**.
